# skill-audit — LGD-Eval 技能审计工具（Skill Audit Tool）
> LLM-friendly entry. / 面向 AI 的入口。

## What (是什么)
Open-source scanner that audits AI skills/agents against governance evidence: Registry completeness, manifest metadata, silent-failure surfaces, mojibake detection. / 开源技能审计扫描器：按治理证据审计技能/智能体——有籍完整性、manifest 元数据、静默失败面、乱码检测。

## Package (包)
- PyPI: `lgd-skill-audit` (Trusted Publishing workflow ready)
- Install: `pip install lgd-skill-audit`

## Key files (关键文件)
- scanner.py — the audit scanner / 扫描器
- pyproject.toml — packaging / 打包配置
- README.md — usage & audit dimensions / 用法与评测维度

*Evaluating Autonomy. Verifying Governance. / 评测自治之物，验证治理主张。*
